methods.method: Fixed-physics Lorenz FPE and reflecting flux
methods.limitations: Continuum linearity is a mathematical derivation under well-posedness; numerical correction may break it.

methods.method: Q1/Q2 upwind advection and full-SPD SIPG diffusion
methods.limitations: Published neighbouring DG constructions do not prove the complete project CN/QP scheme.

methods.method: Stage-1 cell-average repair and constrained local-QP polynomial correction
methods.limitations: Project local polynomial QP differs from the cited paper's average optimisation plus scaling.

methods.method: Whole-cell Bernstein constraints, subdivision and negative witnesses
methods.limitations: Nonnegative Bernstein coefficients suffice; negative coefficients alone do not prove polynomial negativity; retain actual witnesses.

methods.method: Backward Euler, Crank–Nicolson and timestep refinements
methods.limitations: Project equations, residual tests and frozen temporal runs supply evidence; no separate historical time-integrator paper citation recovered.

methods.method: Cell-average AFC/FCT and DOF/subcell convex-limiting alternatives
methods.limitations: AFC runs can complete while scientific gates fail and fallbacks occur; hyperbolic convex-limiting theory is not automatically applicable to full-SPD FPE.

methods.method: Static tensor grading and nonconforming local hex refinement
methods.limitations: Infrastructure support differs from project flux correctness; graded aggregate failures and voxel-only convergence limits remain.

methods.method: Physical-basis DOLFINx/MFEM operator, raw CN, corrected step and trajectory equivalence
methods.limitations: Agreement is scoped numerical evidence, not continuum accuracy or full timestep-history proof.

methods.method: Monte Carlo covariance/bootstrap, marginal and independent reference diagnostics
methods.limitations: Sampling uncertainty and limited statistics cannot establish full-density truth; historical bootstrap methodology lacks an individually recorded external citation.

methods.method: Aligned domain, support/depth and mature timestep sensitivity
methods.limitations: AMR_LOCAL denotes project design evidence rather than an external publication; small voxel sensitivity is not continuum certification.

methods.method: Chang–Cooper, structure-preserving FD, anisotropic FV, Hermite and semi-Lagrangian challengers
methods.limitations: Cited challenger families do not establish that every candidate was implemented or qualified; recent preprints retain dimension and mixed-diffusion restrictions.

methods.method: Historical Gaussian/Gaussian-mixture mature initial laws and Bayesian regression tests
methods.limitations: Preserved regression inputs; no authority to substitute them for accepted attractor inputs.

methods.method: RK4 Lorenz finite-window empirical occupation law and histogram reconstruction
methods.limitations: Correlated temporal samples, declared reconstruction and regularization; no iid or posterior-coverage inference.

methods.method: Bin-free empirical top-hat convolution and exact overlap integration
methods.limitations: KDE context; particle-filter convergence hypotheses not verified for fixed-bandwidth deterministic occupations.

methods.method: Paired-box mixture L1 upper bound and conservative-grid contraction
methods.limitations: Original project derivation from overlap and triangle inequality; no external theorem attribution invented; pairing bound can be loose.

methods.method: Empirical law to volume density, FE projection, conservative voxel averages, float32 and training scaling
methods.limitations: G01 v1 failed arithmetic/bitwise replay; v2 passed unchanged thresholds. New box candidate FE transfer is unqualified.

methods.method: Block resampling, ACF/effective sample size and reconstruction-phase diagnostics
methods.limitations: Conditional reconstruction replicates are not independent paths; ESS is observable-specific heuristic evidence.

methods.method: Full-density likelihood-times-prior Bayes update
methods.limitations: G00 has small conditioned diagnostics, not a complete DA cycle. Kalman/variational/state-closure substitutions excluded.

methods.method: Density-only 3D FNO, positivity/normalization, CUDA training
methods.limitations: Original guide is recorded; original paper added retrospectively in this audit, not claimed as historical design provenance. Scientific moment/boundary failures remain.

methods.method: Persistence and nearest-target diagnostics; learned linear/POD/CNN candidates
methods.limitations: Linear baseline required by fixed FPE linearity; no historical POD/CNN research source recovered, qualification remains locked.

methods.method: Predeclaration, immutable evidence, leakage controls and gate adjudication
methods.limitations: Reporting guidance supports discipline; neither source nor fast CI proves honest scientific qualification.

methods.method: Local RAM backpressure and resumability safeguards
methods.limitations: MemAvailable and process pause/resume are operational; no automatic scientific checkpoint guarantee.
